adjustments.title: Add multiplayer lobbies and player names
adjustments.description: Introduced a lobby system. Players can set custom or randomized names. They can host a new lobby (which generates a unique 5-character code) or join an existing lobby using its code.

proposals.summary: Wire the parent MULTIPLAYER requirement to the lobby contracts to satisfy the check.
Fix link in Children list and provide the Player persona access to the lobby intent to clear the orphan warning.
